newsitem.title: USA: BASEBALL-ORIOLES ACE MUSSINA AGREES TO ONE-YEAR DEAL.
newsitem.headline: BASEBALL-ORIOLES ACE MUSSINA AGREES TO ONE-YEAR DEAL.

text.p: The Baltimore Orioles and star pitcher Mike Mussina agreed on a one-year contract for $6.825 million Friday, splitting the difference in salary the two sides had submitted for an arbitration hearing.
Mussina's arbitration hearing had been scheduled for next Friday. The pitcher submitted a salary demand of $7.1 million while the Orioles came in with an offer of $6.55 million.
The 28-year-old Mussina was 19-11 with a 4.81 ERA last season and has won 19 games each of the last two years. He owns the highest winning percentage among active major leaguers.
"We're still hopeful that we can agree on a long-term deal because Baltimore is where I want to play," Mussina said. "This doesn't change my feeling that we'll be able to finalise a multi-year deal."
Orioles General Manager Pat Gillick said he was pleased to have Mussina under contract for the 1997 season.
"By avoiding arbitration it keeps the dialogue positive and allows us to reopen discussions on a long-term deal should we choose to do so," Gillick said.
